title: HKDF-SHA-256 extract and expand
summary: Derive a 16 to 255 byte key from input keying material, a salt and info with HKDF-SHA-256 (RFC 5869).
notes: One HKDF-Extract (one HMAC-SHA-256) and one to eight HMAC-SHA-256 blocks of HKDF-Expand per call, so the figure is mostly HMAC set-up and the SHA-256 compression function, plus the call's own overhead.
